checkedAlternates.risk: SR-71 was the fastest jet-powered aircraft.
checkedAlternates.resolution: At Mach 3.2, the SR-71 flew in the supersonic regime (group-3), below the Mach 5.0 hypersonic threshold (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Critical Mach occurs while the aircraft is below Mach 1.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Critical Mach marks the onset of local supersonic flow on the wing, defining the start of the transonic regime (group-2).
